attackers_goals: The Windows Server Update Services enable machines to discover and download software updates from a dedicated update server while providing the necessary client characteristics to install the suitable client version and build. Characteristics may consist of computer model, BIOS version and architecture. A unique computer model in the network may indicate an unauthorized and unmanaged connection to the internal network.
description: A unique client computer model was detected via MS-Update protocol.
investigative_actions: Inspect the legitimacy of the host and its hardware components. Verify that this host is not a newly deployed end-point or virtual machine as part of a legitimate IT activity.
name: Unique client computer model was detected via MS-Update protocol
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
